question: An Act to provide for mental healthcare and services for persons with mental illness and to protect, promote and fulfill the rights of such persons is called ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mental Healthcare Act, 2017.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mental Healthcare Act, 2017** was enacted by the **Indian Parliament **on **April 7, 2017**.
 
• The Act aims to provide **mental healthcare and services** to people with mental illness and protect their rights.
 
• It also seeks to promote** community-based care** and make mental healthcare accessible to all.
 
• The Act recognizes the right to access mental healthcare and treatment and **prohibits discrimination** against people with mental illness.
 
• The Act also establishes a** Mental Health Review Commission** and a **Mental Health Review Board **to oversee the implementation of the Act and address any grievances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A person in a condition of **mental health **is able to **manage life's stressors**, reach their full potential, learn and work effectively, and give back to their community.
 
• It is a vital aspect of **health and wellbeing** that supports our capacity as individuals and as a society to make choices, form bonds with one another, and influence the world we live in.
 
• A** fundamental human right** is mental health.
 
• Furthermore, it is essential for **socioeconomic, communal, and personal** growth.
